author: Ingolf Lohmann
goal: Formalize separation between a premetric causal ontology and dimensional/numerical measurement representation without promoting the model to empirical physical truth.
intended_result: Show model-theoretically that dimension labels and the numerical representation of an invariant causal propagation speed are not uniquely determined by a bare premetric causal ontology and fixed operational observation/calibration maps.
repository_boundary: The candidate is intentionally outside formalization/QIKVRT_Formalization_v2.0 so the frozen Alpha-2 formalization package remains byte-stable.
scientific_boundaries: Does not prove that nature is fundamentally dimensionless.
Does not prove that measurement ontologically creates physical dimensions.
Does not derive the SI base-unit system.
Does not derive the physical value of c; 299792458 and 1 are representation tokens in the countermodel.
Does not derive hbar or G.
Does not close QCE Planck-scale correspondence, the classical Einstein limit, or universal stress-energy coupling.
A successful Lean build establishes only the declared finite model theorem.
next_physical_bridge: Define a non-arbitrary calibration action whose equivalence classes induce dimension signatures.
Bind the premetric causal boundary to the QCE emergent-spacetime construction.
Derive a unique normalization from QCE dynamics rather than inserting an external scale.
Derive universal stress-energy coupling and the Einstein coefficient before treating G as an output.
